title: EndpointSlice
description: An EndpointSlice represents a subset of the endpoints that implement a Service. For a given Service, multiple EndpointSlices may exist, and together they represent all the pods selected by the Service. The kubernetes.io/service-name label links slices to their Service.

addressType.description: Address type of endpoints in this slice. All endpoints in a single slice must share the same address type.

endpoints.description: List of unique endpoints in this slice. Up to 1000 endpoints per slice.

ports.description: Network ports exposed by each endpoint in the slice.
